description: Calculates South Korea 2026 statutory inheritance and gift tax, progressive tax brackets (10-50%), relationship deductions, and voluntary filing discount.

assetValue.description: Gross market value of assets in KRW

debtValue.description: Liabilities or debts assumed in KRW

hasSpouse.description: Whether surviving spouse exists (inheritance mode only)

isGenerationSkipping.description: Generation skipping surcharge (30%; 40% when a minor receives over 2,000,000,000 KRW)

isMinorRecipient.description: Recipient is a minor (defaults to relationship child_minor)

marriageBirthDeduction.description: Gift from lineal ascendant only: marriage/birth deduction to apply in KRW (lifetime max 100,000,000)

spouseDeduction.description: Inheritance mode: spouse deduction in KRW, clamped to 500,000,000-3,000,000,000 (default 500,000,000)

name: calculate_inheritance_gift_tax
title: calculate inheritance gift tax
